summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Polen Focus Growth ETF (PCLG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in large-cap growth stocks from anywhere in the world. PCLG was launched on Sep 30, 2025 and is issued by Polen.

holdings.infoBox: PCLG is an equity ETF with a total of 28 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 7.93%, Broadcom at 7.48%, Oracle at 7.29%, Alphabet at 6.63%, and Eli Lilly and Company at 6.41%.
